title: Sending the quotation
scene: Delta Pharma is opening a new QC lab and needs a 60 kVA UPS with batteries. Their Procurement Manager sends an RFQ. You send the quotation, then he asks about validity and delivery.
sceneAr: شركة ‎Delta Pharma‎ بتفتح معمل ‎QC‎ جديد ومحتاجة ‎UPS‎ قدرة 60 ‎kVA‎ ببطاريات. مدير المشتريات بعت طلب عرض سعر، وانت هتبعت العرض وبعدين ترد على أسئلته عن مدة السريان والتوريد.

thread.subject: RFQ – 60 kVA UPS for the QC lab
body: Dear NPS Sales Team,
We are upgrading the power backup for our new QC lab in 6th of October City. We need a 60 kVA online UPS with batteries for 30 minutes of backup at full load.
Please send us your best quotation, including installation, commissioning and warranty. Kindly mention the delivery time and payment terms.
We would appreciate your offer by Thursday, 16 October.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: RFQ – 60 kVA UPS for the QC lab
thread.task: ابعت عرض السعر للعميل، واذكر أهم البنود باختصار: المحتويات، السعر، الضمان، وشروط الدفع.

steps.q: Choose the best opening line
steps.why: ‎Thank you for your enquiry‎ هي البداية المهنية المعتادة؛ الباقي يا ترجمة حرفية يا كاجوال زيادة.

steps.sentence: Please find attached our ___ Q-2025-231 for the 60 kVA online UPS and battery bank.
steps.why: ‎quotation‎ هو المصطلح الرسمي لعرض السعر؛ ‎price paper‎ ترجمة حرفية.

parts: Thank you for your enquiry.
Please find attached our quotation Q-2025-231 for the 60 kVA online UPS and battery bank.
Payment terms are 60 days from the invoice date, subject to a signed PO.
Please let me know if you have any questions.
steps.why: شكر ← المرفق ← الشروط ← عرض المساعدة في الآخر.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Thank you for your enquiry. Please find attached our quotation Q-2025-231 for the 60 kVA online UPS and battery bank.
The offer includes one 60 kVA UPS, 40 batteries (12V 100Ah) for 30 minutes of backup, installation, commissioning and a two-year warranty. The total is EGP 1,575,000, excluding 14% VAT.
Payment terms are 60 days from the invoice date, subject to a signed PO.
Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: RFQ – 60 kVA UPS for the QC lab
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the quick reply. Two points are not clear in your offer.
How long is the quotation valid? Also, what is the exact delivery time? Our lab opening is planned for early December.
Please also confirm if the price includes delivery to our site. Our site is about 40 km from Cairo, and we need a clear total cost for our internal approval.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: RFQ – 60 kVA UPS for the QC lab
thread.task: وضّح مدة سريان العرض وميعاد التوريد بالظبط، وأكّد إن السعر شامل التوصيل للموقع.

steps.sentence: The quotation is ___ for 30 days, until 13 November 2025.
steps.why: بنقول ‎valid for 30 days‎ عن مدة سريان العرض.

steps.q: Choose the best way to confirm delivery is included
opts: Yes, the price includes delivery and offloading at your 6th of October site.
Delivery is on you, of course no.
Yes, the price is including the delivery to your site sure.
steps.why: الأولى واضحة وصحيحة؛ التالتة غلط في القواعد، والتانية معناها عكس المطلوب.

parts: Thank you for your questions.
Please see our answers below.
The quotation is valid for 30 days, until 13 November 2025.
I hope this is clear.
steps.why: شكر ← تمهيد للإجابات ← الإجابات بالترتيب ← جملة ختام.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Thank you for your questions. Please see our answers below.
1. Validity: The quotation is valid for 30 days, until 13 November 2025.
2. Delivery: The UPS is in stock. The batteries need 3–4 weeks from the PO date. If we receive your PO by 26 October, we can install before 25 November.
3. Delivery to site: Yes, the price includes delivery and offloading at your 6th of October site.
I hope this is clear. Please do not hesitate to contact me.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: The quotation is valid for 30 days.
Please do not hesitate to contact me.

title: Following up on the quotation
scene: A week has passed and Delta Pharma has not replied to your quotation. You follow up, and the client says a competitor is 8% cheaper. You defend your value and offer a limited discount.
sceneAr: عدّى أسبوع والعميل ما ردّش على العرض. هتتابع معاه، وهو هيقولك إن في منافس أرخص بـ 8%. لازم توضّح قيمة عرضك وتدّي خصم محدود بشروط.

thread.subject: Follow-up – Quotation Q-2025-231 (60 kVA UPS)
thread.task: تابع مع العميل بأدب من غير ضغط، وفكّره إن التوريد محتاج وقت، واعرض مساعدة.

steps.q: Choose the best follow-up opening
opts: Why did you not reply to our offer yet?
Kindly revert back urgently regarding the offer.
I am following up on our quotation Q-2025-231 for the 60 kVA UPS, sent on 14 October.
steps.why: التالتة مهذبة ومحددة؛ الأولى فيها لوم، والتانية فيها ‎revert back‎ وضغط مالوش لازمة.

steps.sentence: Have you had a ___ to review it?
steps.why: التعبير الثابت: ‎Have you had a chance to‎...?

steps.sentence: Looking forward to your ___.
steps.why: ‎Looking forward to your feedback‎ ختام شائع ومؤدب.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
I hope you are well. I am following up on our quotation Q-2025-231 for the 60 kVA UPS, sent on 14 October.
Have you had a chance to review it? I would be happy to arrange a short call or a site visit if you need more details.
As a reminder, the batteries need 3–4 weeks, so an early PO will help us meet your December opening.
Looking forward to your feedback.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Follow-up – Quotation Q-2025-231 (60 kVA UPS)
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for following up.
To be honest, we received another offer for a similar 60 kVA UPS that is about 8% cheaper than yours. Management is asking me to go with the lower price.
I prefer to work with NPS because of your good service on our other sites. If you can improve your price, we can issue the PO next week.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: Follow-up – Quotation Q-2025-231 (60 kVA UPS)
thread.task: ما تنزلش السعر على طول؛ وضّح قيمة عرضك الأول، وبعدين اعرض خصم محدود مربوط بميعاد أمر الشراء.

steps.q: How do you start a price negotiation politely?
opts: Thank you for being open with us.
The other company is bad quality, trust me.
Impossible, our price is final and fixed.
steps.why: ابدأ بشكر وهدوء؛ ما تهاجمش المنافس وما تقفلش الباب.

steps.sentence: To support this project, we can offer a special ___ of EGP 75,000.
steps.why: ‎discount‎ هي الكلمة الصح للخصم؛ ‎sale‎ يعني تخفيضات المحلات.

parts: Thank you for being open with us.
We value Delta Pharma as a long-term client.
Our price also includes a local service team with a 4-hour response time.
The new total is EGP 1,500,000, excluding VAT, if we receive your PO by 30 October.
steps.why: شكر ← تقدير العلاقة ← القيمة ← العرض الجديد بشرط.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Thank you for being open with us. We value Delta Pharma as a long-term client.

Before comparing prices, please check that the other offer includes the same backup time, installation, commissioning and a two-year warranty. Our price also includes a local service team with a 4-hour response time.
To support this project, we can offer a special discount of EGP 75,000. The new total is EGP 1,500,000, excluding VAT, if we receive your PO by 30 October.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Follow-up – Quotation Q-2025-231 (60 kVA UPS)
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the revised offer and for the clear comparison points.
I shared your answer with our management, and they agreed that the service and warranty make a real difference.
Management has approved your price of EGP 1,500,000, excluding VAT. Please send us the revised quotation so we can raise the PO this week.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: Follow-up – Quotation Q-2025-231 (60 kVA UPS)
thread.task: اشكر العميل على الموافقة، وابعت العرض المعدّل، ووضّح الخطوة الجاية بعد أمر الشراء.

steps.q: Choose the best reaction to the good news
opts: Finally! We were waiting a long time.
Great news, thank you for your confirmation.
steps.why: رد إيجابي ومهني؛ الأولى فيها عتاب، والتانية ناشفة.

steps.sentence: All other terms ___ the same.
steps.why: ‎All other terms remain the same‎ جملة ثابتة في العروض المعدلة.

parts: Great news, thank you for your confirmation.
All other terms remain the same.
Once we receive your PO, we will confirm the delivery schedule within 24 hours.
We look forward to working with you on this project.
steps.why: الرد على الخبر ← تفاصيل العرض ← الخطوة الجاية ← ختام.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Great news, thank you for your confirmation.
Please find attached our revised quotation Q-2025-231 Rev.1 with the new total of EGP 1,500,000, excluding 14% VAT. All other terms remain the same.
Once we receive your PO, we will confirm the delivery schedule within 24 hours.
We look forward to working with you on this project.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: I am following up on our quotation ...
بتابع معاك بخصوص عرض السعر بتاعنا ...
Have you had a chance to review it?
Thank you for being open with us.
Before comparing prices, please check that ...
قبل ما تقارن الأسعار، اتأكد إن ...
To support this project, we can offer ...
علشان ندعم المشروع ده، نقدر نقدّم ...
All other terms remain the same.

title: Following up on the PO
scene: Delta Pharma promised the PO last week, but it has not arrived and the battery order deadline is close. When the PO finally comes, the battery quantity and the total price are wrong. You ask for a corrected PO.
sceneAr: العميل وعد يبعت أمر الشراء الأسبوع اللي فات ولسه ما وصلش، وميعاد طلب البطاريات قرّب. ولما أمر الشراء وصل، كان فيه غلط في عدد البطاريات وفي السعر، فهتطلب أمر شراء مصحح.

thread.subject: PO status – Quotation Q-2025-231 Rev.1
thread.task: العميل وعد بأمر الشراء وما بعتوش؛ اسأل عليه بلطف، ووضّح تأثير التأخير على ميعاد التركيب.

steps.q: Choose the best way to remind the client of his promise
opts: You promised the PO and you did not send it.
On 26 October, you mentioned that the PO would be issued last week, but we have not received it yet.
steps.why: التانية بتفكّر بالحقيقة من غير اتهام؛ الأولى لوم مباشر، والتالتة وقحة.

steps.sentence: Could you please let me know the ___?
steps.why: ‎Could you please let me know the status‎? طريقة مهنية للسؤال عن حاجة متأخرة.

parts: Could you please let me know the status?
The battery supplier needs our order by 6 November to deliver on time.
Any delay after that may move the installation to December.
Thank you for your support.
steps.why: السؤال ← السبب ← تأثير التأخير ← شكر.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
I hope you are doing well. On 26 October, you mentioned that the PO would be issued last week, but we have not received it yet.
Could you please let me know the status? The battery supplier needs our order by 6 November to deliver on time. Any delay after that may move the installation to December.
Thank you for your support.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: PO-2025-118 – 60 kVA UPS
body: Dear <Your name>,
Sorry for the delay. The PO was waiting for our Plant Director's signature, and he was travelling last week.
Please find attached PO-2025-118 for the 60 kVA UPS project. Kindly confirm receipt and the delivery date, as the lab opening is still planned for early December.
Our facilities team will be your contact for the installation.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: PO-2025-118 – 60 kVA UPS
thread.task: لاحظت إن أمر الشراء فيه غلط في عدد البطاريات وفي الإجمالي؛ وضّح الفرق بالأرقام واطلب أمر شراء مصحح.

steps.q: How do you point out a mistake politely?
opts: You made two mistakes in the PO.
However, we noticed two differences from our revised quotation Q-2025-231 Rev.1:
The PO is wrong, please make it again.
steps.why: ‎we noticed two differences‎ بتوصف المشكلة من غير ما تلوم حد.

steps.sentence: Could you please send us a ___ PO?
steps.why: بنقول ‎corrected PO‎ أو ‎revised PO‎.

parts: Thank you for sending PO-2025-118.
We confirm receipt.
Could you please send us a corrected PO?
We will start the order as soon as we receive it.
steps.why: شكر وتأكيد استلام ← (توضيح الفروق) ← الطلب ← الخطوة الجاية.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Thank you for sending PO-2025-118. We confirm receipt.
However, we noticed two differences from our revised quotation Q-2025-231 Rev.1:
1. Batteries: the PO shows 32 units, but the quotation includes 40 units (12V 100Ah) for 30 minutes of backup.
2. Total price: the PO shows EGP 1,575,000, but the agreed total is EGP 1,500,000, excluding VAT.
Could you please send us a corrected PO? We will start the order as soon as we receive it.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: PO-2025-118 – 60 kVA UPS
body: Dear <Your name>,
You are right, and thank you for checking. Our team used the first version of your quotation.
Please find attached PO-2025-118 Rev.1 with 40 batteries and a total of EGP 1,500,000, excluding VAT. The old PO is now cancelled.
Please go ahead with the battery order today, so we do not lose any more time. Our facilities contact is Eng. Mona Adel.

Best regards,
Khaled Samir
Procurement Manager
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: PO-2025-118 – 60 kVA UPS
thread.task: أكّد استلام أمر الشراء المصحح، وحدد ميعاد التوريد والتركيب.

steps.sentence: We confirm ___ of PO-2025-118 Rev.1
steps.why: التعبير الصح: ‎confirm receipt of‎؛ ‎reception‎ معناها الاستقبال في الفندق.

steps.q: Choose the best sentence about the schedule
opts: Delivery to your site is planned for 20 November.
We will deliver maybe around 20 November, inshallah we see.
Delivery is 20 November if God wants and the supplier also.
steps.why: الأولى واضحة ومحددة؛ الباقي مش مؤكد وترجمة حرفية.

parts: Thank you for the quick correction.
We have placed the battery order today.
Delivery to your site is planned for 20 November, and installation and commissioning will be on 23–24 November.
Our project engineer will contact your facilities team to arrange site access.
steps.why: شكر ← اللي اتعمل ← المواعيد ← الخطوة الجاية.

body: Dear Eng. Khaled,
Thank you for the quick correction. We confirm receipt of PO-2025-118 Rev.1, and everything is now in line with our quotation.
We have placed the battery order today. Delivery to your site is planned for 20 November, and installation and commissioning will be on 23–24 November.
Our project engineer will contact your facilities team to arrange site access.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Sales Engineer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: Could you please let me know the status?
We have not received it yet.
Could you please send us a corrected PO?
everything is now in line with our quotation

title: Issuing the e-invoice
scene: The UPS is installed and you issue the e-invoice on the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) system. Delta Pharma rejects it because their tax registration number is wrong. You apologise, cancel the invoice and issue a new one.
sceneAr: الـ ‎UPS‎ اتركب وانت أصدرت الفاتورة الإلكترونية على منظومة الضرايب. الحسابات عند العميل رفضتها علشان رقم التسجيل الضريبي غلط. هتعتذر وتلغي الفاتورة وتصدر واحدة جديدة.

thread.subject: E-invoice INV-0457 – PO-2025-118 Rev.1
thread.task: ابعت لحسابات العميل الفاتورة الإلكترونية ومحضر التسليم، ووضّح المبلغ والضريبة.

steps.q: Choose the best way to link the invoice to the work
opts: The 60 kVA UPS was installed and commissioned on 24 November, and the handover report was signed by your facilities team.
We finished the work, so now pay us.
The UPS is done and working very good.
steps.why: الأولى بتذكر التاريخ والمستند الموقّع، وده اللي الحسابات محتاجاه.

steps.sentence: We have ___ e-invoice INV-0457 on the ETA system for PO-2025-118 Rev.1.
steps.why: بنقول ‎issue an invoice‎؛ ‎cut an invoice‎ ترجمة حرفية من «قطعنا فاتورة».

parts: We have issued e-invoice INV-0457 on the ETA system for PO-2025-118 Rev.1.
The amount is EGP 1,500,000 plus 14% VAT (EGP 210,000), a total of EGP 1,710,000.
Please find attached the invoice PDF and the signed handover report.
steps.why: رقم الفاتورة ← المبلغ ← المرفقات.

body: Dear Ms. Dalia,
I hope you are well. The 60 kVA UPS was installed and commissioned on 24 November, and the handover report was signed by your facilities team.
We have issued e-invoice INV-0457 on the ETA system for PO-2025-118 Rev.1. The amount is EGP 1,500,000 plus 14% VAT (EGP 210,000), a total of EGP 1,710,000.
Please find attached the invoice PDF and the signed handover report.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: E-invoice INV-0457 – PO-2025-118 Rev.1
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the invoice. Unfortunately, we cannot accept it.
The tax registration number on the invoice is 318-452-907, but our correct number is 318-425-907, so our system rejected it.
Please cancel this invoice and issue a new one with the correct number. We cannot process the payment until then.

Best regards,
Dalia Fawzy
Accounts Payable
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: E-invoice INV-0457 – PO-2025-118 Rev.1
thread.task: اعتذر عن الغلط بشكل مختصر، واشرح سببه، وأكّد إنك هتلغي الفاتورة وتصدر جديدة وامتى.

steps.q: Choose the best apology
opts: Sorry, it's the system's fault, not ours.
Thank you for letting us know, and I apologise for the mistake.
OK no problem, we will see.
steps.why: اعترف بالغلط واشكرهم إنهم نبهوك؛ ما ترميش اللوم على السيستم.

steps.sentence: We will ___ INV-0457 on the ETA system today and issue a new e-invoice with the correct number, 318-425-907.
steps.why: على المنظومة الفاتورة بتتعمل لها ‎cancel‎ مش ‎delete‎.

parts: Thank you for letting us know, and I apologise for the mistake.
Two digits in your tax registration number were entered in the wrong order.
You should receive it by tomorrow at the latest.
Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
steps.why: اعتذار ← السبب ← (الإجراء) ← الميعاد ← اعتذار ختامي.

body: Dear Ms. Dalia,
Thank you for letting us know, and I apologise for the mistake. Two digits in your tax registration number were entered in the wrong order.
We will cancel INV-0457 on the ETA system today and issue a new e-invoice with the correct number, 318-425-907. You should receive it by tomorrow at the latest.
Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: Reissued e-invoice INV-0461 (replaces INV-0457)
thread.task: ابعت الفاتورة الجديدة، ووضّح إنها بدل القديمة وإن المبلغ ما اتغيرش، واطلب تأكيد قبولها على البوابة.

steps.sentence: The amount has not ___: EGP 1,710,000, including 14% VAT.
steps.why: ‎The amount has not changed‎ = المبلغ زي ما هو.

steps.q: Choose the best request
opts: Could you please accept the invoice on the ETA portal and confirm that it has been registered in your system?
I hope you will maybe accept it if possible.
steps.why: طلب واضح ومؤدب ومحدد؛ الأولى أمر، والتالتة مش واضحة.

parts: As promised, we have cancelled INV-0457 and issued a new e-invoice, INV-0461, with your correct tax registration number, 318-425-907.
The amount has not changed: EGP 1,710,000, including 14% VAT.
The invoice date is 27 November 2025.
steps.why: اللي اتعمل ← المبلغ ← التاريخ (وده مهم لحساب الاستحقاق).

body: Dear Ms. Dalia,
As promised, we have cancelled INV-0457 and issued a new e-invoice, INV-0461, with your correct tax registration number, 318-425-907.
The amount has not changed: EGP 1,710,000, including 14% VAT. The invoice date is 27 November 2025.
Could you please accept the invoice on the ETA portal and confirm that it has been registered in your system?

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Reissued e-invoice INV-0461 (replaces INV-0457)
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the quick action. INV-0461 has been accepted on the ETA portal and registered in our system.
It will now follow our normal payment cycle. I will share the expected payment date with you once our finance team prepares the payment plan for next month.
Thank you for your support.

Best regards,
Dalia Fawzy
Accounts Payable
Delta Pharma

phrases: Thank you for letting us know.
Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
glossary: فاتورة إلكترونية على منظومة مصلحة الضرائب

title: Payment terms and the due date
scene: INV-0461 has 60-day payment terms. You write to Delta Pharma's accounts to confirm the due date. They ask to split the payment into two cheques with an extra month, so you agree to a shorter schedule.
sceneAr: الفاتورة شروط دفعها 60 يوم. هتكلم حسابات العميل تأكد ميعاد الاستحقاق. هما هيطلبوا يقسموا المبلغ على شيكين وياخدوا شهر زيادة، وانت هتوافق على جدول أقصر.

thread.subject: Payment due date – INV-0461
thread.task: أكّد مع حسابات العميل ميعاد الاستحقاق حسب شروط الدفع، واسأل عن طريقة الدفع.

steps.q: Choose the best opening for a payment email
opts: I would like to confirm the payment details for INV-0461 (EGP 1,710,000), which was accepted on 27 November.
Please give us our money on time.
steps.why: ‎I would like to confirm‎... بداية لطيفة ومحددة؛ الباقي مباشر زيادة.

steps.sentence: According to our agreed terms of 60 days from the invoice date, the payment is ___ on 26 January 2026.
steps.why: ‎due on‎ = مستحق في تاريخ معين.

parts: I would like to confirm the payment details for INV-0461 (EGP 1,710,000), which was accepted on 27 November.
According to our agreed terms of 60 days from the invoice date, the payment is due on 26 January 2026.
Could you please confirm this date and let us know the payment method, bank transfer or cheque?
Thank you in advance.
steps.why: الموضوع ← التاريخ وسببه ← الطلب ← شكر.

body: Dear Ms. Dalia,
I hope you are well. I would like to confirm the payment details for INV-0461 (EGP 1,710,000), which was accepted on 27 November.
According to our agreed terms of 60 days from the invoice date, the payment is due on 26 January 2026.
Could you please confirm this date and let us know the payment method, bank transfer or cheque?
Thank you in advance.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Payment due date – INV-0461
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for your email. I confirm the due date of 26 January.
However, because of our cash flow plan, our finance department would like to pay in two post-dated cheques: 50% on 26 January and 50% on 26 February.
We have always paid on time, and we would like to keep a good relationship with NPS. Please let me know if this is acceptable.

Best regards,
Dalia Fawzy
Accounts Payable
Delta Pharma

thread.subject: RE: Payment due date – INV-0461

Thank you for confirming the due date.
We understand your cash flow plan and we are happy to support Delta Pharma. However, our agreed terms are 60 days, so a full extra month is difficult for us.
We can accept two post-dated cheques as follows:

- Cheque 1: EGP 855,000, dated 26 January 2026
- Cheque 2: EGP 855,000, dated 15 February 2026
We would also need to receive both cheques by 20 January. Could you please confirm this schedule?

Best regards,
<Your name>

body: Dear Mr. Hany,
I would like to escalate an overdue payment from Delta Pharma.
Invoice INV-0538 for EGP 96,900 (replacement batteries) was due on 23 March. We sent four reminders, the last one a final reminder on 21 June, but we have received no reply.
Delta Pharma is an important client, and they paid the UPS project in full, although one cheque was returned in February.
I suggest that you contact their Finance Manager directly, and that we put new orders on hold until payment. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Escalation – Delta Pharma – INV-0538 (EGP 96,900)
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the clear summary. I called their Finance Manager, Mr. Samy Ragab, this morning.
They agreed to pay EGP 50,000 by bank transfer on 2 July and the balance of EGP 46,900 by 16 July.
Please confirm the agreement with Ms. Dalia in writing and keep me posted.

Best regards,
Hany Zaki
Finance Director | Nile Power Solutions

body: Dear Ms. Dalia,
Following the call today between our Finance Director, Mr. Hany Zaki, and Mr. Samy Ragab, I would like to confirm the agreed payment plan for INV-0538:

- EGP 50,000 by bank transfer on 2 July 2026
- EGP 46,900 by bank transfer on 16 July 2026
Please add the invoice number to the transfer reference. Once the full amount is received, we will release the hold on your account.
Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accounts Receivable | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Payment agreement – INV-0538
body: Dear <Your name>,
We confirm the payment plan above. Sorry for the delay, and thank you for your patience.
Our treasury team has already scheduled the first transfer. I will send you the transfer confirmation on 2 July, with the invoice number in the reference.
Please also send us the new statement of account after the final payment.

Best regards,
Dalia Fawzy
Accounts Payable
Delta Pharma
